CLAUSES.title: Protective hold authority (ADV-T-002)
CLAUSES.statement: Every platform-originated hold or freeze (security incident, break-glass, fail-closed safety gate) SHALL execute a hold policy the sponsor adopted in its master agreement, SHALL be time-bounded (expiring or converting to a sponsor decision within a sponsor-approved window, default one business day), SHALL notify the sponsor's designated officer immediately, SHALL NOT move, reverse or redirect funds, and SHALL leave the sponsor able to pay through its own bank channel. Fail-closed safety gates that stop Unbound from relaying an instruction are within this policy. Each hold SHALL be evidenced with actor, reason, scope and expiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a break-glass freeze with no sponsor decision after one business day, when the window ends, then the freeze expires or converts to a recorded sponsor decision.
Given a platform freeze, when the sponsor pays a grant directly through its bank portal, then nothing in Unbound prevents it and the payment is reconciled on the next feed.
CLAUSES.activation_gate: Sponsor master agreement adopting the hold policy.
CLAUSES.activation_conditions: Sponsor master agreement adopting the hold policy.

CLAUSES.title: Tenant unit, administrator principal and shared stores (ADV-T-006, ADV-T-019, ADV-T-024)
CLAUSES.statement: Isolation profiles SHALL be selected per legal sponsor; partner and program isolation SHALL be enforced inside the sponsor cell by typed partitioning and negative tests, and a partner needing dedicated infrastructure SHALL be served by a dedicated sponsor cell or a separate legal sponsor. An Administrator principal type SHALL hold a per-sponsor ServiceDelegation (task classes, data classes, expiry) recorded in each sponsor's cell; a federated queue projection SHALL contain only routing metadata (case id, kind, priority, due time, sponsor id) and no donor PII; opening an item SHALL authenticate into that sponsor's cell under the delegation. A normative SharedStoreRegister SHALL list each cross-tenant store with permitted fields and classification, writers, readers and inference risks; donor and advisor PII SHALL NOT enter any shared store except as a keyed token for authorized checks.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator user without a delegation for sponsor B, when they open a B case from the federated queue, then access is refused.
Given a new cross-tenant store not in the register, when deployment runs, then the release check fails.

CLAUSES.title: One authority matrix (ADV-T-008)
CLAUSES.statement: A single normative AuthorityMatrix SHALL map each command class × actor type {deterministic policy, AI agent, staff role, appointed officer, board} × authority level, replacing the coexisting tier vocabularies; 'Tier 2' SHALL mean only enhanced human review (CNV-GRT-011). Every API command SHALL declare its class; commands absent from the matrix SHALL be refused.
acceptance_criteria: Given a command not mapped in the matrix, when invoked, then it is refused with UnclassifiedCommand.

CLAUSES.title: Decision dossiers resistant to injection (ADV-T-009)
CLAUSES.statement: Dossiers prepared for human or batch decisions SHALL render deterministic findings (eligibility, sanctions, holds, related-party, Tier-2 triggers) in a separate section built from sources and hashes that AI cannot edit or reorder; AI narrative SHALL be labelled, SHALL quote untrusted sources only as quoted data, and SHALL never alter a finding; batch approval SHALL be refused for items whose deterministic section shows an unresolved trigger.
acceptance_criteria: Given a charity web page containing instructions to approve, when a dossier is generated, then the text appears only as quoted source and the deterministic section is unchanged.
Given a batch containing an item with an unresolved sanctions finding, when batch approval is attempted, then that item is excluded.

CLAUSES.title: Service-organization evidence retention (ADV-T-013)
CLAUSES.statement: Unbound SHALL keep a 'service-organization evidence' class (operator access, change, deployment and IPE run records) separate from tenant records, holding only minimum tenant identifiers, for at least the longest of the SOC period plus three years, the Nacha audit horizon or the contractual period; it SHALL be listed on the exit certificate and survive tenant deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sponsor exit and deletion of tenant data, when the evidence store is queried for that period, then operator-access and change records remain.

CLAUSES.title: Strata scope and authoritative history (ADV-T-018)
CLAUSES.statement: Strata SHALL be used for declarative schema governance where its supported PostgreSQL versions match production. Authoritative append-only history SHALL be an Unbound-owned ledger component on managed PostgreSQL. Strata version support SHALL be a precondition checked before each database major-version upgrade; deterministic mock interactions SHALL be Unbound-owned provider contracts until Strata virtualization exists.
acceptance_criteria: Given a planned PostgreSQL major upgrade outside Strata's supported range, when the upgrade is scheduled, then it is blocked or Strata is removed from that path by recorded decision.

CLAUSES.title: Engineering insider and change controls (ADV-T-023, ADV-T-035)
CLAUSES.statement: Modules tagged control-relevant (gate, ledger, reservations, holds, authority, dispatch) SHALL require two approvers on every change, neither the author; builds SHALL be signed with recorded provenance; each release SHALL publish to each sponsor a notice listing changed control-relevant modules; production data access by engineers SHALL follow CNV-ARC-002. Every authorization decision, policy evaluation, eligibility gate, capacity or fee computation and state transition SHALL be computed or re-verified on the server inside the command transaction; client-side results SHALL be advisory display only and API contracts SHALL NOT accept client-computed results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change to the dispatch module approved only by its author and one other engineer, when merged, then the release check fails.
Given an API request carrying a client-computed capacity value, when processed, then the value is ignored and recomputed on the server.

CLAUSES.title: Contact-channel changes and accessible assurance (ADV-T-025, ADV-T-026)
CLAUSES.statement: A change to any verified contact channel SHALL notify the previous channel with a self-service revert link; for a sponsor-set period (default 72 hours) afterwards, successor and beneficiary changes, authority changes and grant recommendations above a sponsor threshold SHALL be held for confirmation. An AccessibleAssurancePath SHALL offer at least a one-time code mailed to the verified address, an outbound call to a verified number, assisted video with captioning and in-person or notarized verification, each reaching a defined contact assurance level; relay calls SHALL be accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email change followed by a successor change within 72 hours, when submitted, then the successor change is held and the previous email notified.
Given a deaf donor without a smartphone, when they need CAL3 to change bank details, then a documented accessible path reaches CAL3.

CLAUSES.title: Status projection and policy precedence (ADV-T-028, ADV-T-029)
CLAUSES.statement: A normative StatusProjection table SHALL map every reachable combination of payment, grant and contribution state dimensions to a donor label, a charity label, a staff label, an approved explanation and the next expected event or date, with a staff disclosure matrix by role. Policies SHALL follow the precedence law > platform non-removable > sponsor board policy > program terms > fund agreement > donor preference, and a policy pack SHALL be statically checked at adoption against the lattice and other active packs, rejecting rules that overlap with different outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reachable state combination with no projection row, when the projection check runs, then it fails.
Given a pack rule that would let program terms override a non-removable control, when adopted, then adoption is rejected.

CLAUSES.title: Long-running process versioning and database fleet operations (ADV-T-033, ADV-T-005)
CLAUSES.statement: Every process instance SHALL record the definition and policy versions it started under; a new definition SHALL apply only to new instances unless an explicit, tested migration function records a MigrationApplied fact per instance and never shortens a statutory or contractual deadline. Fleet provisioning SHALL be declarative and version-controlled (provider-native templates permitted; no Kubernetes or Terraform requirement), schema changes SHALL be expand/contract so release N runs against schema N-1 and N, migration state SHALL be recorded per tenant, and a failed tenant migration SHALL stop the rollout and leave other tenants serving.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successor window shortened in a new policy version, when applied, then existing instances keep their original deadline.
Given a migration failing for one tenant, when rolling out, then the rollout halts and other tenants remain on the prior compatible release.

CLAUSES.title: Rail-partner resilience (ADV-T-037)
CLAUSES.statement: Each sponsor SHALL approve a maximum funds-in-transit exposure per rail partner, enforced on partner funding requests. A partner outage SHALL move unsent instructions to the fallback rail only after the partner confirms non-execution or the instruction reaches the unknown-outcome process (CNV-PAY-004); partner insolvency SHALL trigger a recovery plan for funds in transit, recorded as a sponsor receivable.
acceptance_criteria: Given a partner funding request that would exceed the approved exposure, when presented, then it is refused.
Given a partner outage with unconfirmed instructions, when failover is requested, then those instructions are not re-sent until non-execution is confirmed.

CLAUSES.title: Baseline integrity and numeric basis (ADV-T-010, ADV-T-011, ADV-T-032, ADV-T-041)
CLAUSES.statement: Each baseline row SHALL carry a SHA-256 of its exact source text plus file and line, its status derived from adoption markers, and, for convergence clauses, its approval basis and resolving questions. Every clause classified as an internal control SHALL map to at least one entry in the authoritative control register, which SHALL record control operator {Unbound, sponsor, administrator, rail partner, custodian}, report relevance {SOC1, SOC2, none}, complementary user entity control id, automated or manual and the evidence query. Clause dependencies SHALL be declared and the dependency graph SHALL be acyclic. Numeric values in normative clauses SHALL carry a basis tag {authority, business-policy default, empirical target, illustrative}.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clause dependency cycle, when the baseline is generated, then generation fails.
Given a control clause without a control-register mapping, when the baseline validator runs, then it reports the clause.
